title: Kids With the Greatest Number of Candies
goal: For each child, decide whether giving them all extra candies would reach the greatest count.
strategy: Find the original maximum once. Give the extra candies hypothetically to one child at a time, allowing ties.

phasePurposes.inspect: Find the original maximum once. Give the extra candies hypothetically to one child at a time, allowing ties.
phasePurposes.update: Each child is compared independently against the original maximum.
phasePurposes.done: Each child is compared independently against the original maximum.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
